blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Aleson Flor pulled off a surprise victory in a field packed with veteran and elite keglers, emerging as the Sugbuanon Bowlers United (SUGBU) Bowler of the Month for September on Sunday, October 4, at the SM Seaside Bowling and Leisure Center. Flor topped the five-game series with 1,063 pinfalls to edge first runner-up Marvin Villar, who finished just 11 pins behind with 1,052. Manny Bueno completed the podium with 1,040 pinfalls. Rusty Mago placed fourth with 1,029, while Joma Avila rounded out the top five with 1,022. MORE SPORTS NEWS: Dumanjug, Mandaue, Balamban, Moalboal score wins in […]...
